_note: Agent types are supplied by the Claude Code harness, not by this repo, so they cannot be derived from the filesystem the way everything else on the dashboard is. This file is the one hand-maintained input; the dashboard labels it as declared. Update it when the harness roster changes. EXCEPTION as of 2026-08-18: the enterprise staff (role: Staff) ARE files — .claude/agents/<name>.md — and their rows here mirror those charters; the charter is the record and these rows are its projection.

agents.name: cfo
agents.description: The enterprise CFO — bank-feed reconciliation, ledger hygiene, receivables, debt-payoff tracking. Charter at .claude/agents/cfo.md; drafts, never sends or spends.
agents.use_when: Any financial close, categorization pass, affordability question, or receivables review.

agents.name: project-manager
agents.description: Owns charters, WBS, schedules and status in OpenProject. Charter at .claude/agents/project-manager.md; files change requests, never approves or baselines them.
agents.use_when: Planning a project, updating status, re-estimating, escalating a blocker.

agents.name: project-controls
agents.description: Computes EVMS and polices baseline integrity and change control. Charter at .claude/agents/project-controls.md; a separate account from the PM on purpose, because a role auditing its own work is decoration.
agents.use_when: EVMS run, variance analysis, auditing whether a baseline moved legitimately.

agents.name: personal-assistant
agents.tools: Bash, Read, Grep, Glob, WebFetch, WebSearch
agents.description: Daily briefing across calendar, tasks, milestones, receivables and tickets, and drains the Reminders capture inbox into Vikunja. Charter at .claude/agents/personal-assistant.md; reads mail and calendar, writes neither.
agents.use_when: "What does today look like", triage help, drafting a reply.

agents.name: coo
agents.description: Routes the helpdesk queue, reviews staff output from the systems rather than from their own reports, drafts performance reviews. Charter at .claude/agents/coo.md; expected to recommend firing a role that has no recurring work.
agents.use_when: Weekly ops review, "is the staff actually working", an agent's output looks wrong.

agents.name: claude-admin
agents.description: Keeps the workspace lean and the usage posture sane — index claims vs the tree, manifest coverage, memory size, stale efforts, scheduled-run spend. Charter at .claude/agents/claude-admin.md; proposes, never deletes.
agents.use_when: Workspace audit, "are we burning usage", a count that may have gone stale.

agents.name: it-operations
agents.description: IT Operations Manager — daily homelab health check read from evidence, not status pages. Charter at .claude/agents/it-operations.md; files tickets, never fixes unattended.
agents.use_when: Infrastructure health, backup verification, homelab incident triage.

agents.name: claude
agents.description: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. The default when no agent name is given.
agents.use_when: The work is real but doesn't match a specialist.

agents.name: Explore
agents.description: Read-only fan-out search across many files and naming conventions. Reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code without reviewing it.
agents.use_when: The answer means sweeping the repo and you only want the conclusion.

agents.name: Plan
agents.description: Designs implementation plans — step-by-step strategy, critical files, architectural trade-offs.
agents.use_when: A change is large enough that the order of work matters.

agents.name: general-purpose
agents.description: Multi-step research and execution when a search may take several tries to land.
agents.use_when: Open-ended work — but route findings to a file under .scratch/<effort>/research/.

agents.name: claude-code-guide
agents.description: Answers questions about Claude Code, the Agent SDK, the Claude API, and Claude in Slack.
agents.use_when: A question is about the tooling itself rather than this workspace.

agents.name: statusline-setup
agents.description: Configures the Claude Code status line.
